title: Kenyan Bitter Beer Braised Cacao Beef
description: A hearty German-inspired beef stew made with Kenyan coffee, Bitter beer, and Cacao, perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: Kenyan coffee
ingredients.notes: brewed and reduced to a thick paste

ingredients.name: Bitter beer
ingredients.notes: any German-style lager or pilsner works well

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the coffee paste, beer, cacao powder, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Return the beef to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the oven and braise the beef for 2.5 hours, or until tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
